stepGenericDescription: Rotate the model and follow the highlighted parts for this step.
gestureHint: Drag to rotate · Pinch to zoom
reviewHint: Build complete — tap a step or use Previous to review
selectModelHint: Choose a model to view its build instructions
settingsLineContrastHint: High contrast uses hard black/white edges; Standard keeps LDraw edge colors.
settingsStudContrastHint: Solid black stud walls improve readability; Off keeps part colors.
settingsStudLogoHint: Draw the LEGO line logo on top of studs.
studReloadNote: Changing stud options reloads model geometry.
settingsHighlightHint: Distinguish new parts from the built model. Red/green modes use edge highlighting on mobile.
settingsAnimationHint: How fast the model/camera rotates when changing steps.
settingsPerfExpHint: A/B toggles to isolate jank. Both off by default.
settingsPerfExpDeferHint: On: skip full material rebuild before step animation. Smoother motion, possible brief artifacts.
settingsPerfExpLowHint: On: no 2× supersample, MSAA 1, DPR=1 while dragging. Tests fill-rate jank.
